reserves.name: USDC routed through Venus lending markets (via soul-bound sUSDC)
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Circle Internet Financial, Inc. and SoulPeg Venus strategy

reserveReview.rationale: SoulPeg documents SPUSD as a tradeable ERC-20 wrapper for 1:1 sUSDC, with deposited USDC routed into Venus lending markets. The protocol describes single-sided USDC lending and on-chain verifiability; current Venus liquidity and strategy balances remain dynamic.
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The sole tracked USDC dependency is identified, but current Venus market allocation and available redemption liquidity change over time.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: SoulPeg identifies on-chain strategy and Venus contracts but does not establish legal segregation, bankruptcy remoteness, or rehypothecation treatment for deposited USDC.
